meta.note: annualized rate = month exits × 12 ÷ average headcount, average = (start + end) ÷ 2; exit months from resignation/lifecycle LWD records only (RPT-08 definition, FIN-077)
meta.kpiDefinition: Annualized Attrition Rate = (exits in month × 12) ÷ ((headcount at month start + headcount at month end) ÷ 2)
warnings: 1 former employee(s) carry a terminal status with no lifecycle record — they are excluded from this report. Record their exit in Resignation & Exit to attribute them.

meta.note: rate = absent employee-days ÷ scheduled working employee-days (weekly-offs and holidays excluded); population follows joins and exits per month (FIN-078)
meta.kpiDefinition: Absenteeism Rate = ABSENT employee-days on scheduled working days ÷ scheduled working employee-days

meta.note: hourly basis = effective-dated basic ÷ 208h; tier multipliers follow the vendor OT rates; Payroll OT = the period's non-draft, non-cancelled runs (regular + adjustments)
meta.kpiDefinition: Estimated OT Cost = Σ over OT minutes of (minutes ÷ 60) × (basic in force that day ÷ 208) × day-type multiplier
